stops.name: Lake Alpsee
stops.quote: The “Wasserläufer” traverses the foothills of the Alps, full of rivers, waterfalls and lakes, including the Lech, Lake Alpsee and the Scheidegger waterfall.
stops.english: The “Wasserläufer” traverses the foothills of the Alps, full of rivers, waterfalls and lakes, including the Lech, Lake Alpsee and the Scheidegger waterfall.

stops.name: Alpspitz
stops.quote: The higher mountain country is crossed by the “Himmelsstürmer”, which encompasses peaks such as the Alpspitz in Nesselwang, the Grünten near Burgberg and the Nebelhorn, or “foghorn”, near Oberstdorf.
stops.english: The higher mountain country is crossed by the “Himmelsstürmer”, which encompasses peaks such as the Alpspitz in Nesselwang, the Grünten near Burgberg and the Nebelhorn, or “foghorn”, near Oberstdorf.

stops.name: Nebelhorn
stops.quote: Winter paradise on the Nebelhorn: off-piste in fresh snow and a night in the "Igloo Lodge" at 2,000 metres.
stops.english: Winter paradise on the Nebelhorn: off-piste in fresh snow and a night in the "Igloo Lodge" at 2,000 metres.

stops.name: Hochgratbahn
stops.quote: And when you run out of steam, mountain railways such as the Hörnerbahn in Bolsterlang or the Hochgratbahn in Oberstaufen make the ascent much easier to manage.
stops.english: And when you run out of steam, mountain railways such as the Hörnerbahn in Bolsterlang or the Hochgratbahn in Oberstaufen make the ascent much easier to manage.

stops.name: Neuschwanstein Castle
stops.quote: Füssen, on Lake Forggensee, is overshadowed by Neuschwanstein Castle, the realisation of the medieval dream and spectacular hideaway of Ludwig II.
stops.english: Füssen, on Lake Forggensee, is overshadowed by Neuschwanstein Castle, the realisation of the medieval dream and spectacular hideaway of Ludwig II.

stops.name: Princely Abbey
stops.quote: The 18th century Princely Abbey is a truly splendid building.
stops.english: The 18th century Princely Abbey is a truly splendid building.

stops.name: Benedictine Abbey
stops.quote: Ottobeuren is famous for its remarkable work of art, the Baroque Benedictine Abbey.
stops.english: Ottobeuren is famous for its remarkable work of art, the Baroque Benedictine Abbey.

stops.name: Nagelfluhkette Nature Park
stops.quote: We accompanied ranger Theresa in the Nagelfluhkette Nature Park to waterfalls, through snow-white dream landscapes and in search of Apollo butterflies
